workload: fresh-session repository read with one required command execution and exact JSON output

quality_contract.expected_test_name: runner keeps one native primary thread across task packets

interpretation: Measured. All eight runs completed with exit code 0 and the expected JSON answer.
Measured. Both arms made one commandExecution call per turn. The trace records two events per call because it reports started and completed.
Measured. The primer control reduced mean fresh-turn time by 27,812.75 ms, or 66.2 percent, in this four-pair probe.
Measured. The sessionStart hook averaged 1,281.5 ms in the trusted arm and 130.75 ms in the control arm.
Exploratory. The exact paired sign-flip p value is 0.125 because n is four. This result clears the task-quality guard for this workload but is not a general quality guarantee.
limitations: One model, repository, task shape, and active personal profile.
The task checks exact read-only behavior and does not measure a code change or a long multi-turn repair.
The comparison uses a runner control arm. It does not change the external Ripwire hook.
